main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). A reconstructed 1,720m Gippsland track featuring a 24m width, long sweeping turns, and a 300m home straight. Early tactical speed ('E' and 'P') holding the fence holds a distinct advantage in 1000m, 1100m, and 1200m sprint dashes.
main_turf.post_bias: INSIDE BARRIER BIAS: Inside barriers (stalls 1–5) hold an advantage in sprint races. Outer draws (9+) face ground-loss penalties unless possessing elite gate speed.

handicapping_angles.gippsland_winter_heavy_mudlarks: Like many Gippsland venues, Moe frequently races on deeply rain-affected ground (Soft 7 to Heavy 10) during Victorian winter cards. Heavily upgrade proven wet-track performers ('Mudlarks') with 2+ wins on heavy going (+4.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.melbourne_metro_shippers: Moe is a major regional target for top Melbourne metropolitan yards (Ciaron Maher, Busuttin/Young, Ben, Will & JD Hayes, Price/Kent Jr.). Upgrade class-dropping Metro runners (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.moe_cup_carnival: During the October Moe Cup ($150k+) feature meeting, race quality elevates to Victorian Provincial grade. Factor in higher speed par offsets for feature races.
